intro: Good evening, gentlemen. Gameweek 5 is done. Results included Brentford 3-0 Chelsea, Spurs 2-3 Aston Villa and Brighton 3-0 Arsenal. Brahmes top-scored with 55; Louie managed 30. Asher leads on 266, 7 clear of Ben. Jack climbs 1 to 5th. Nobody panic.
motw: Brahmes scored 55, the best of the week. Cunha (10), Barnes (9) and Virgil (8) did the heavy lifting. Now 7th on 191.
stinker: 30 points. That's the lot. Haaland top-scored with 6, which tells you how the rest went. Down 1 to 6th.
bench: 20 points left on the bench. Suzuki (2), Vuskovic (8) and Kostoulas (10) watched from the side. Team selection remains an art, not a science.
bench_jam: James didn't play, so Grealish came off Louie's bench and scored 3. Luck is a skill if you say it confidently.
gloves: Raya (Arsenal) scored 1 for Louie. Conceded 3. Made 2 saves, for what it's worth.
